observations.finding: Title page identifies al-Muẓaffar and the named English translator.

PDF p.37 ends its discussion of natural, logical and intellectual universals/species. PDF p.38 immediately begins the inference preface and definition of syllogism corresponding to Book V. This observed join establishes noncontinuous coverage in relation to the six-book authorial sequence.
The final substantive pages cover the closing inference material, induction and analogy, extending through the end of Book V.

metadataCorrection: The earlier assertion that this PDF ended before the definition material was inaccurate as an endpoint claim. It is a partial, noncontinuous comparator extending through Book V. No claim of complete six-book coverage or comprehensive clause-by-clause comparison is made.
